question: By what means and in what manner is one claimed to be shown one's own body?
premises: Showing is claimed as a potential action.
The object is one's own body.
The means is unceasing meditation and the manner is in many ways.
inference: By unceasing meditation, one's own body is claimed to be shown in many ways.
uncertainties: The agent of 'darśayet' is not named in this verse alone.
plain_english: By unceasing meditation one may show one's own body in many ways.
